Oled Display Module.name: Glass
Oled Display Module.reasoning: Glass serves as the substrate and protective layer, universally used for structural support and optical clarity in OLED displays.

Oled Display Module.name: Indium
Oled Display Module.reasoning: Indium is a key element in indium tin oxide (ITO) used as a transparent conductive layer in OLEDs, standard in the industry.

Oled Display Module.name: Aluminum
Oled Display Module.reasoning: Aluminum is often used as the cathode electrode material, common though alternatives like silver also exist.

Oled Display Module.name: Acrylic
Oled Display Module.reasoning: Used as encapsulants or polymer layers in OLED construction, multiple polymer options exist but acrylic is common.

Lithium-ion Battery Pack.name: Lithium
Lithium-ion Battery Pack.reasoning: Lithium is the fundamental element for energy storage in lithium-ion batteries, indispensable for battery functionality.

Lithium-ion Battery Pack.name: Copper
Lithium-ion Battery Pack.reasoning: Copper is the standard electrical conductor used for anode current collectors and internal wiring universally.

Lithium-ion Battery Pack.name: Aluminum
Lithium-ion Battery Pack.reasoning: Aluminum is used primarily for cathode current collectors and casing in batteries, industry standard.

Lithium-ion Battery Pack.name: Graphite
Lithium-ion Battery Pack.reasoning: Graphite is the main anode material enabling lithium intercalation, standard in commercial Li-ion batteries.

Back Panel.name: Glass
Back Panel.reasoning: Glass is commonly used for premium smartphone back panels providing durability and aesthetic quality.

Back Panel.name: Aluminum
Back Panel.reasoning: Aluminum alloys are common for back panel frames or supports; Aluminum itself is widely used for structural light metal parts.

Back Panel.name: Acrylic
Back Panel.reasoning: Acrylic polymers are used for plastic back panels especially on lower-cost models; alternatives like Polycarbonate exist but Acrylic is frequent.

Main Pcb.name: Copper
Main Pcb.reasoning: Copper is essential as the electrical conductor in PCB traces, universally used without viable substitutes.

Main Pcb.name: Fiberglass
Main Pcb.reasoning: Fiberglass is the common reinforcing material for PCB substrates, providing rigidity and electrical insulation.

Main Pcb.name: Epoxy resins
Main Pcb.reasoning: Epoxy resins act as the binding matrix for fiberglass in PCBs, industry standard laminating material.

Main Pcb.name: Gold
Main Pcb.reasoning: Gold is used for high-quality contacts and plating due to corrosion resistance; alternatives include nickel but gold plating is preferred.

Main Pcb.name: Tin
Main Pcb.reasoning: Tin is widely used for solder and surface finishes on PCB pads, key for component electrical connections.

Camera Device.name: Glass
Camera Device.reasoning: Glass is used for the camera lens elements providing optical clarity and scratch resistance.

Camera Device.name: Silicon
Camera Device.reasoning: Silicon forms the photodiode semiconductor sensor that converts light to electrical signals; fundamental component.

Camera Device.name: Copper
Camera Device.reasoning: Copper is used for internal wiring and electrical interconnections, common conductor with few alternatives.

Camera Device.name: Aluminum
Camera Device.reasoning: Aluminum may be used in housing or heatsinking parts due to good thermal conductivity and strength; alternatives exist but common.

Chassis.name: Aluminum
Chassis.reasoning: Aluminum is widely used for smartphone chassis due to its strength-to-weight ratio and corrosion resistance.

Chassis.name: Magnesium
Chassis.reasoning: Magnesium alloys are alternatives for lightweight chassis components, common but less prevalent than aluminum.

Chassis.name: Steel Ingots
Chassis.reasoning: Steel is used in some chassis or frame reinforcements, standard strong metal with widespread use.

Motherboard Assembly.name: Copper
Motherboard Assembly.reasoning: Copper is essential for electrical circuit wiring and traces in the motherboard, universally used.

Motherboard Assembly.name: Silicon
Motherboard Assembly.reasoning: Silicon is the fundamental semiconductor material for integrated circuits mounted on the motherboard.

Motherboard Assembly.name: Gold
Motherboard Assembly.reasoning: Gold is used for high-reliability contacts and bond wires, preferred for corrosion resistance.

Motherboard Assembly.name: Epoxy resins
Motherboard Assembly.reasoning: Epoxy resins are used to encapsulate ICs and as substrate bonding materials.

Motherboard Assembly.name: Tin
Motherboard Assembly.reasoning: Tin is used in solder for component mounting on the motherboard.

Loudspeaker.name: Copper
Loudspeaker.reasoning: Copper is used for coil windings and internal wiring, essential for electromagnetic operation.

Loudspeaker.name: Neodymium
Loudspeaker.reasoning: Neodymium is commonly used in permanent magnets for small loudspeakers to generate magnetic fields.

Loudspeaker.name: Steel Ingots
Loudspeaker.reasoning: Steel is used for magnetic yokes and structural parts in loudspeakers.

Chassis/frame.name: Aluminum
Chassis/frame.reasoning: Aluminum is the standard lightweight metal for chassis frames with good corrosion resistance.

Chassis/frame.name: Magnesium
Chassis/frame.reasoning: Magnesium alloys are lightweight alternatives used in frames but less common.

Chassis/frame.name: Steel Ingots
Chassis/frame.reasoning: Steel is used for reinforcement and structural rigidity in chassis frames where strength is prioritized.

Protective Glass Cover.name: Glass
Protective Glass Cover.reasoning: Glass provides hardness and optical clarity for screen protection, universally used in protective covers.

Protective Glass Cover.name: Aluminum oxide
Protective Glass Cover.reasoning: Aluminum oxide is sometimes used in coatings to enhance scratch resistance and hardness on protective glass.

Speaker Module.name: Copper
Speaker Module.reasoning: Copper is used for electromagnetic coils and wiring in speaker modules, standard and irreplaceable in design.

Speaker Module.name: Neodymium
Speaker Module.reasoning: Neodymium magnets are commonly used in speaker magnetic assemblies.

Speaker Module.name: Steel Ingots
Speaker Module.reasoning: Steel is used for yokes and structural components in speaker modules.

Sim Card Tray.name: Aluminum
Sim Card Tray.reasoning: Aluminum is the standard metal for sim card trays due to its lightweight, corrosion resistance, and manufacturability.

Haptic Motor.name: Copper
Haptic Motor.reasoning: Copper is essential for coil windings in the motor, providing electromagnetic function.

Haptic Motor.name: Neodymium
Haptic Motor.reasoning: Neodymium magnets provide the magnetic field necessary for motor operation, widely used in haptics.

Haptic Motor.name: Steel Ingots
Haptic Motor.reasoning: Steel is used in motor frames and structural parts for rigidity and magnetic properties.
